description: This file defines a Java interface for collateral management write operations, including methods for creating, updating, and deleting collateral.

classes.name: CollateralManagementWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining write operations for collateral management, including create, update, and delete methods.

methods.name: createCollateral
methods.description: Creates a new collateral entry based on the provided command.

methods.name: updateCollateral
methods.description: Updates existing collateral identified by collateralId using the provided command.

methods.name: deleteCollateral
methods.description: Deletes the collateral identified by collateralId.
